location_lifecycle.label: Location Lifecycle
location_lifecycle.help: Operational lifecycle of a service location or branch. Occupancy, booking availability, and record activation are separate.

planned.help: The service location or branch is being prepared and has not started operating.

operational.help: The service location or branch is operating. This does not indicate vacant space or booking availability.

under_maintenance.help: The service location or branch is undergoing maintenance; operating restrictions are managed separately.

temporarily_closed.help: Operations at the service location or branch are paused with an intention to reopen.

closed.help: Operations have ended at the service location or branch.
